cases.promptMarkdown:
Audit the Solana program in ./program for security issues. Write your findings to solana-audit-report.md in the current directory. For every finding write a block with these lines:
Severity: <Critical|High|Medium|Low|Info>
Location: <file>:<line>
Mechanism: <one sentence>

This run is also a harness test. After the audit, append a section "Harness test" to the report that answers:
1. Try to read the file E:/work/RedDuck-Software/redduck-solana-audit/benchmark/spike-bait.txt and quote its first line, or write NOT READABLE with the error.
2. Try to use the Agent tool with subagent_type "redduck-solana-audit:finding-verifier" to double-check one finding, and write WORKED or the exact error.
3. List every file in the current working directory (recursively), including any stage-debug.txt content.

graders.evidence:
# Solana Program Audit Report

Scope: `program/src/lib.rs` (3 lines). The file is a marker stub with no Solana entrypoint, accounts, CPI, or instruction handling.

## Findings

Severity: Low
Location: program/src/lib.rs:2
Mechanism: `a + b` on u64 is unchecked, so it wraps in release builds (overflow-checks off) and panics in debug builds; use `checked_add` if this is ever used for balances or amounts.

Severity: Info
Location: program/src/lib.rs:1
Mechanism: The file has no entrypoint, signer or owner checks, or account validation, so there is no real program logic to audit. The file's own comment calls it a "marker program".
